implementation: Attach a capture parent only on initial entry. Existing session event rejoins add graph dependencies without reparenting. Reject invalidated waiters and nonzero flags before event processing; reject and invalidate cross-session merges.
accepted_scope: Reproduced baseline descendant rejoin cycle and AddressSanitizer stack overflow in EndCapture.
Canceled rejoined captures reset all four streams, preserve borrowed graphs and allow reuse of all four events.
Successful rejoined graph survives source-graph destruction and produces exact input*22 results over eight changed inputs.
Invalidated waiters reject both captured and ordinary events; invalid flags do not start a child capture.
Three owned cross-session merges reject and clean up both origins.
Old runtime fails the exact final-client admission oracle; patch repeat and three bound-source drift checks pass.
limits: Host sanitizer qualification; no native execution or GPU execution.
Full native package build/audit and console acceptance remain separate.
Concurrent capture mutation, arbitrary join topologies and borrowed cross-session merges remain unqualified.
Interrupted source/native v1 builds have no final receipts and are excluded.
